plain_english_policy: This bill amends an existing local statute to allow Limestone County Commissioners to use sales and use tax revenue specifically for refinancing the county's public building debt.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would authorize the redirection of current or future sales/use tax collections in Limestone County toward paying off specific bonds, warrants, or other debt instruments used to finance public buildings. The bill establishes that these funds must be deposited into designated accounts and applied immediately upon availability for refinancing purposes.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors (Representatives White, McCutcheon, and Hammon) affirmatively advanced legislation to amend Act No. 2001-557 regarding Limestone County's debt management.
evidence_quotes: "Relating to Limestone County; to amend Act No. 2001-557... to authorize the Limestone County Commission to apply taxes authorized by the act to payment of refinanced debt."

"The revenue and remittances to Limestone County pursuant to this act shall be deposited in one or more designated accounts to be used solely to pay and retire the bonds, warrants, or other debt instruments..."
